chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-'Ammar ibn Marwan, from al-Munkhil, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about this verse in the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: "And if you are killed in the Path of Allah, or die". He said: Then he said: Do you know what the Path of Allah is? I said: No, by Allah, except that I hear it from you. He said: The Path of Allah is Ali (peace be upon him) and his offspring, and the one who is killed in his Divine Authority is killed in the Path of Allah, and the one who dies in his Divine Authority dies in the Path of Allah.

key_terms.سَبِيلُ اللَّهِ: The Path of Allah, interpreted here as the authority of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Path of Allah' in the context of martyrdom and Wilayah?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) provides a specific exegetical interpretation (tafsir) of the phrase 'Path of Allah' in Surah Al Imran, identifying it not merely as the battlefield, but as the spiritual and political authority (Wilayah) of Imam Ali and his progeny. This establishes a theological link between martyrdom in the cause of divine leadership and the Quranic concept of jihad, emphasizing that loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt is the essence of following God's path.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Muhammed bin Hussain, from Muhammed bin Sinan, from Ammar bin Marwan, from Munkhil, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, that he said:

I asked him about this verse in the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And if you are killed in the Path of Allah, or die» [3:157]. He said: Then he said: Do you know what the Path of Allah is? He said: I said: No, by Allah, except that I hear it from you. He said: The Path of Allah is Ali, peace be upon him, and his offspring. With regards to the Path of Allah, the one who is killed (for the sake of- and whilst believing) in his Divine Authority, is killed in the Path of Allah, and the one who dies (whilst believing) in his Divine Authority, dies in the Path of Allah.
